gh pr create --base main --head fix/issue-7-refresh-loop --title "Fix refresh() recursing forever on expired session" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fixes #7.

## Problem
`refresh(session)` in `src/auth.js` returned `refresh(session)` when the session had expired. That passes the same expired session back in, so the call never returns and the page freezes.

## Change
When the session is expired, `refresh()` now returns `fetchSession()` instead of recursing.

## Needs review
`fetchSession` is not defined or imported anywhere in this repository (`src/auth.js` is the only source file). The issue refers to it as an existing function, so I did not add one. Until it is defined and imported, an expired session throws `ReferenceError: fetchSession is not defined` instead of freezing. Please confirm where `fetchSession` lives, or tell me the intended implementation so I can wire it in.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
